# Cardo v0.3.0

Cardo becomes a composable Windows desktop application shell, with five framework crates and an independent application template.

- `cardo-app`: application identity, ordered startup, maintenance routing, main window, launch delivery and service lifetime.
- `cardo-platform`: single instance, system icons, native file pickers and process helpers.
- `cardo-ui`: shared panels/chrome, target-window dialog content, close reasons, Toast lifetime/dragging, settings and task delivery.
- `cardo-runtime`: opt-in TOML, SQLite, localization and diagnostics; task cancellation, drafts and command bindings.
- `cardo-update`: configured release discovery, bounded download, verification, backups, application and recovery through product adapters.
- Cardo Desk template: independent identity/workspace, real background SHA-256 task, settings, About and notifications; updates disabled by default.
- Separate English/Chinese documentation and retained dependency notices. GPUI Kit stays at 0.6.1; the purple cube is unchanged.

This is a breaking framework API release. Consumers must explicitly select optional services and provide application policy. No data imports, compatibility adapters or schema migrations are supplied. Windows is the implementation target; macOS/Linux support is not promised.

See `docs/verification.md` for local build and observed runtime coverage. GUI edge cases and isolated update apply/rollback remain listed verification gaps; a successful build does not establish them.
